name: 使用 SAP Business Network for Procurement 的集中采购 (6BJ)
name_en: Central Procurement with SAP Business Network for Procurement (6BJ)
description_en_html:
Overview

Integrating SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud Edition with SAP Business Network through SAP Integration Suite, managed gateway for spend management and SAP Business Network supports the exchange of documents related to standard procurement processes, such as purchase orders and order confirmations.

Create central purchase orders in central procurement hub system by pooling purchase orders from connected systems, such as SAP ERP, SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, SAP S/4HANA or ECC. The purchase orders are sent to SAP Business Network and the required suppliers are notified. Suppliers submit their order confirmation through SAP Business Network. The supplier's order confirmation is sent from SAP Business Network to either hub or connected system. As soon as the supplier starts the release and approval process for a purchase order, the status is updated in the connected system.

Key Process Flow

  • Create purchase orders in the connected system such as SAP ERP, SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, SAP S/4HANA or ECC

  • Extract purchase orders to the central procurement hub system (SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition)

  • Approve purchase orders to view it in the Manage Purchase Orders Centrally app in the hub system

  • Send purchase order output electronically from central procurement hub system

  • Receive purchase order in SAP Business Network for Procurement

  • Create order confirmation as a supplier in SAP Business Network for Procurement

  • Determine the confirmation creation based on the supplier confirmation relevance indicator

  • Transfer the order confirmation to the Manage Central Supplier Confirmations app in the hub system and further to the connected system or

  • Transfer the order confirmation to the connected system

Business Benefits

  • Speed up procurement processes

  • Improve compliance

  • Increase productivity in accounts payables and procurement departments

  • Increase productivity of procurement and accounts payable staff

  • Reduce inquiries about payments from suppliers
description_zh_html:
概览

通过面向支出管理的 SAP Integration Suite 托管网关和 SAP Business Network 将 SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud Edition 与 SAP Business Network 集成，支持交换与标准采购流程（例如订购单和订单确认）相关的文档。

通过从连接系统（例如 SAP ERP、SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition、SAP S/4HANA 或 ECC）集中采购订单在集中采购中心系统中创建集中采购订单。订购单将发送到 SAP Business Network，并通知所需供应商。供应商通过 SAP Business Network 提交订单确认。供应商的订单确认从 SAP Business Network 发送到中心系统或连接的系统。供应商开始采购订单的审批和审批流程后，状态将在连接的系统中更新。

关键流程流

  • 在连接的系统（例如 SAP ERP、SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition、SAP S/4HANA 或 ECC）中创建采购订单

  • 将采购订单提取到集中采购中心系统（SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition）

  • 批准采购订单，以在“集中管理采购订单”应用的中心系统中查看

  • 从集中采购中心系统以电子方式发送采购订单输出。

  • 在 SAP Business Network for Procurement 中接收采购订单

  • 在 SAP Business Network for Procurement 中作为供应商创建订单确认

  • 根据供应商确认相关性标识确定确认创建。

  • 将订单确认传输到中心系统中的 管理集中供应商确认 应用，然后传输到连接的系统或

  • 将订单确认传输到连接的系统

业务优势

  • 加快采购流程

  • 提高合规性

  • 提高应付账款和采购部门的生产力

  • 提高采购和应付账款人员的工作效率

  • 减少关于供应商付款的询问
